Problem Statement
Write a program to perform conversions using Java Wrapper Classes and display the converted values.
Description
Read a numeric string and perform the following operations:
Convert the String into an Integer using Wrapper Classes.
Convert the Integer into a Double.
Add 100 to the Integer value.
Display all values.

250
